Correlation Plot

plot_corrplot.Rd

Draw a correlation matrix heatmap. Currently supported data types:

  • glystats_cor_res: Result from glystats::gly_cor().

  • SummarizedExperiment: A glyexp::GlycomicSE(), glyexp::GlycoproteomicSE(), or other compatible container. Correlation analysis is first performed using glystats::gly_cor(), then the result is plotted.

Usage

plot_corrplot(
  x,
  ...,
  label = FALSE,
  digits = 2,
  triangle = "lower",
  title = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  fontsize = 9,
  family = "sans",
  palette = NULL,
  stats_args = list()
)

# S3 method for class 'glystats_cor_res'
plot_corrplot(
  x,
  ...,
  label = FALSE,
  digits = 2,
  triangle = "lower",
  title = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  fontsize = 9,
  family = "sans",
  palette = NULL
)

# S3 method for class 'glyexp_experiment'
plot_corrplot(
  x,
  ...,
  stats_args = list(),
  label = FALSE,
  digits = 2,
  triangle = "lower",
  title = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  fontsize = 9,
  family = "sans",
  palette = NULL
)

# S3 method for class 'SummarizedExperiment'
plot_corrplot(
  x,
  ...,
  stats_args = list(),
  label = FALSE,
  digits = 2,
  triangle = "lower",
  title = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  fontsize = 9,
  family = "sans",
  palette = NULL
)

Arguments

x

An object to be plotted.

...

Must be empty. Supply plotting controls by their full argument names.

label

Whether to display correlation coefficients in cells.

digits

Number of decimal places for coefficient labels.

triangle

Part of the matrix to display: "lower" (default), "upper", or "full". Colors always span -1 to 1.

title

Optional plot title. Defaults to NULL.

width, height

Plot-area dimensions in millimetres. NULL uses the tidyplots defaults (50 by 50 mm); NA fills the available graphics device. These are not export-page dimensions.

fontsize

Base text size in points. Defaults to 9.

family

Font family. Defaults to "sans".

palette

Color vector. A named vector maps group names to fixed colors across plots and subsets; unnamed palettes follow factor order. NULL uses tidyplots palettes. Heatmaps and correlation plots use the blue, near-white, and red anchors of colors_diverging_BuRd. Volcano plots use grey for points that do not meet both cutoffs. Other plots use the tidyplots defaults for discrete and continuous values.

stats_args

A list of keyword arguments to pass to glystats::gly_cor().

Value

A tidyplot object, also inheriting from ggplot.
